metadata.source: Paramus Borough Municipal Directory & School Board Rosters

staff.name: Christopher DiPiazza
staff.title: Mayor of Paramus
staff.notes: Elected Mayor leading Paramus Borough Council policy and municipal proceedings.

staff.name: Hector Olmo
staff.title: Borough Administrator
staff.notes: Chief administrative officer directing daily municipal operations, capital projects, and labor relations.

staff.name: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
staff.title: Certified Municipal Finance Officer (CMFO)
staff.notes: Oversees municipal debt service, annual operating budget preparation, and tax billing.

staff.name: Robert M. Guidetti
staff.title: Chief of Police
staff.notes: Commands uniformed patrol, emergency 911 communications, detective bureau, and traffic safety.

staff.name: Certified Tax Assessor
staff.title: Tax Assessor (CTA)
staff.notes: Maintains certified MOD-IV property assessment roll and defends assessments before Bergen County Tax Board.

staff.name: Superintendent of Schools
staff.title: District Superintendent
staff.notes: Chief administrative and instructional officer for Paramus Borough public school district.

staff.name: School Business Administrator
staff.title: Board Secretary & SBA
staff.notes: Manages public school annual operating budget, facilities capital bonds, and state aid accounting.
